scope: All primary benchmark cases, with no outcome or convergence filtering; not all GTEx genes.
definition: Exact signed float64 LD columns; first-nonzero sign canonicalization and signed-zero normalization; hash candidates followed by exact array equality. G counts classes, not rank.
input_verification: All 14157 eQTL metadata and raw LD SHA256 digests matched the frozen input manifest during the completed census.
limitation: Classes describe locally prepared LD. Historical runtime associations do not establish identical equality classes in independently reconstructed Burgundy timing matrices.
